title: woopoly incorrectly allows duplicate sku in primary language
variations without price or out of stock are not translated
body:
In case you care about this, the filter to hook is woocommerce_hide_invisible_variations
which is true by default, which means that variations which have no price of are not in stock are not translated.
Probably this plugin itself should hook this filter within variable.php function duplicateVariations() 

the line in woocommerce is:
`			if ( apply_filters( 'woocommerce_hide_invisible_variations', true, $this->get_id(), $variation ) && ! $variation->variation_is_visible() ) {`
 
so the function would be eg:
add_filter('woocommerce_hide_invisible_variations', function(){return false;});

My question is why not drop the current product completely and return a new one ? This can cause incompatibilities with other plugins too, not just "WooCommerce Dynamic Pricing & Discounts".

title: Forced product translations
body:
_First of all, this is my first time on github (and I'm in every way a complete rookie) The plugin is amazing and does what it has to do but I encountered a personal problem. If you read this and think this does not belong on github, please refer me to an alternative forum / site where I could find my answer_

**The reason I downloaded this plugin:**
- When a product was added to the cart in for example the french page, and the customer clicked checkout or view cart, they would go to the english checkout or cart page.
Same for german (redirected to english) 
The dutch page did function correctly though. (add to cart in dutch and you would go to the dutch checkout or cart page)

This problem was solved by installing the plugin immidiately. 

**My problem:**
The plugin forced polylang to turn on product translations so if people go to the german store there would be no products (matching the selection) because all the products are set to english by default.
 (weird thing: this appeared after 2 days, while the other things were fixed immidiately.)
I could fix this by translating all the products but there are hundreds of them and this would take weeks.

**Question:
Does anybody have a fix so the customers will be directed to the right checkout and cart page, without me having to translate all the products?**

Many thanks!

title: Translated product category loses its parent
body:
Hi,

I have a product category that is "brand" which I have translated to Swedish.  And under that different ski brands, like Salomon and Volkl. The ski brands name are obviously the same for both English and Swedish, but I give them different slugs (e.g. salomon-en and salomon-sv). But. Whenever I try to save a brand (or the Swedish equivalent) to it's place under the parent category, the linked Swedish brand name loses it's place under it's parent. Hard to explain ... Should two identically named categories (en and sv) with different slugs be able to exist? Or what am I missing here? 

All the best
A

title: Fix Ajax endpoint URL again, fixes #319
body:
Another change in WC_AJAX->get_endpoint() implementation - see
woocommerce/woocommerce#19139 - this time it returns relative URLs.
This breaks Polylangs home_url() filter, which can't handle them.

We have to use woocommerce_ajax_get_endpoint filter to alter the
AJAX endpoint URL according to the current language - replace the
path part of the URL with the correct relative home URL and append
the query string. 

This approach is compatible with the latest WooCommerce implementation.
It returns relative home URL of the site, depending on the current language.
So it shouldn't be bugged with potential issues of reverting to the old 
WooCommerce 3.1 way, which have been mentioned at 
https://github.com/woocommerce/woocommerce/issues/19741#issuecomment-381909917

This pull request fixes #319 .

title: Coupon memory leak in certain circumstances
body:
registerCouponStringsForTranslation()

To fix, the line:
`
            $coupons_loaded = true;
`
needs to be moved to the earliest available point in the function, ie directly after: 
`        if (! $coupons_loaded) {
`

This was detected when running WooCommerce Extended Coupon Features PRO apparently in combination with Abandoned Cart Lite for WooCommerce.
Regular memory limits and timeouts exceeded appeared to coincide with Abandoned Cart Lite checking abandoned carts in cron mode, so no user errors visible until entire php process hangs.

Additionally, in this context there is no user request / user language, so language detection may not work, and arguably language features should be turned off.
Recent updates to Polylang may have affected Polylang behaviour in this type of situation.

Steps to Reproduce
Setup at least 2 languages, let's say EN = default, FR
Set a product, translate it into the 2 languages and set the stock to 3
Add 1 of that product into the basket while in FR
proceed to checkout an pay with a payment platform like Paypal or Payzen.
Once the paiment done, close the page before the redirect to your website.
Make sure an IPN was send to your website.
Your order is received, the stock of the product will be 1 in EN and 3 in FR !

What I Expected
to have 2 as stock in every language as it was 3 and you bought 1.

What Happened Instead
When called via IPN, the stock update update 2 times the default language instead of one time each, I digged and found the issue that  can be fixed like this:

by removing these lines in Stock.php

`$productID = Utilities::get_order_item_productid($item);
$productObject = wc_get_product($productID);`

Somehow, when called thru IPN, the get_order_item_productid function returns the product id of the default language product instead of the selected product.

I checked the wc-stock-function.php and changed thos two lines by this:

`$productObject = $item->get_product();
$productID = $productObject->get_id();`

Then, I removed the

`unset($translations[$orderLang]);`

and simply skipped the current product in the translations loop:

`if ($ID == $productID) continue;`

title: Coupon translations is inefficient
body:
The 1.0.3 coupon strings translation is inefficient.

This is actually causing the coupons posts to be queried on every page load in order to register them for translation:
`            add_action('wp_loaded', array($this, 'registerCouponStringsForTranslation'));    `

In fact the Coupon strings are rarely actually seen, just in certain circumstances on Cart or Checkout and possibly some emails and customizations.

There are a number of possible optimisations for consideration.
eg: Only load the strings for:
1.  the strings translation table in wp-admin
2. specific pages + a filter so customizations can cause the translations to be loaded elsewhere if they need them, OR a different hook in wooCommerce to catch when coupon strings may actually be needed.

Also, as a general optimisation point, perhaps there are a number of initialisation points and checks which can be skipped if the current language is the shop base language.

title: activation causes infinite loop in wp-admin with some other plugin (and memory exhausted)
body:
When a plugin such as XML-RPC (https://wordpress.org/plugins/manage-xml-rpc/) is installed and active,

the activation of woo-poly-integration causes an infinite loop and memory exhaustion in wp-admin (only in wp-admin)

This problem can probably happen with other plugins as well...
 
If we deactivate xml-rpc, woo-poly-integration will activate sucessfully. But then if we activate xml-rpc the infinite loop will happen again…
 
the problem is linked to the call to "flush rewrite rules", i guess that there is an infinite loops which eats all memory there. Here is some code showing how some changes will avoid the problem (but do not fix it obviously):
 
- in "endpoints.php" if we comment out "flush_rewrite_rules();" ("function rewriteEndpoints()")  then both plugins can live together
 
- similarlly if we leave your "endpoints.php" untouched, and comment out  the function " mxr_htaccess_contents" in xml-rpc (which call $wp_rewrite->flush_rules) then both plugin can also live together

It was extremely hard to find out where the problem occurs, so maybe a check/notification to avoid this crash or a solution might be useful :)

regards
philippe
